description: Check that a codice fiscale is well formed, layer by layer: format, check character, a real birth date, a place code valid on that date, and optionally the surname and name letters. It says whether the code is written correctly, not whether the Agenzia delle Entrate has assigned it (only its own service does).

code.description: Codice fiscale, 16 characters (spaces and lowercase accepted).

name.description: Optional name to match against characters 4-6.

surname.description: Optional surname to match against characters 1-3.

name: verify_codice_fiscale
title: Verify a codice fiscale
